name: Telegram Desktop
layout_summary: Left column: hamburger menu and 'Search' input at top-left, scrollable chat list below. Right pane: top header showing contact/group name (clicking opens profile info panel), message history in center, and 'Write a message...' input bar at bottom with attachment paperclip, emoji, and microphone/send icon.
avoid_traps: Pressing 'escape' closes the currently open chat and unfocuses the message input — only press 'escape' when you want to close a modal or leave the current chat.
Clicking the contact name in the top header opens the User Info sidebar rather than focusing the chat box.

search_chat.visual_fallback: smart_type('Search input at top-left', contact_or_query, submit=true)
search_chat.verify: Left sidebar filters to matching chats and contacts

send_message.primary: smart_type('Write a message... input at bottom', message_text, submit=true)
send_message.visual_fallback: smart_click('Write a message... at bottom') -> type_text(message_text) -> press_key('enter')
send_message.verify: Message bubble is sent and appears at bottom of conversation

close_or_back.verify: Closes active media preview, profile sidebar, or current chat

up_down_chats.verify: Switches to the next or previous chat in the left list
